note: 学习目标与理解测验（讲稿 v2 起；审查与测验都对照它）。题目以迁移题为主，干扰项来自真实误解；前测、看片、后测、讲回来。AI 学生只用来筛题，最终以真人盲测为准（edu_videos/_shared/research/explainer_benchmark.md）。

objectives.zh: 能用自己的话说出今天的 AI（机器学习）和传统程序的区别：不是人把规则写好，而是给带答案的例子，让它自己找出规律
objectives.en: Explain in their own words how today's AI (machine learning) differs from a traditional program: instead of people writing the rules, it is given examples with answers and finds the pattern itself

objectives.zh: 判断一件事更适合写规则还是更适合从例子里学：规则说得清（算工资）就写规则；说不清、写不完（认手写数字）才需要学
objectives.en: Judge whether a task suits hand-written rules or learning from examples: clear rules (payroll) can be written; rules nobody can spell out (reading handwriting) call for learning

objectives.zh: 知道模型的本事来自见过的例子：本期实验里例子越多，在没见过的考题上越准；要用没见过的数据来检验
objectives.en: Know that a model's ability comes from the examples it saw: in this episode's experiment, more examples meant higher scores on unseen questions; it must be tested on data it never saw

objectives.zh: 把今天的 AI 看成一台带把握的预测机器：把握高不等于一定对；碰到没学过的东西，它照样会给出答案
objectives.en: See today's AI as a prediction machine with a confidence level: high confidence does not mean correct, and it will still answer when shown something it never learned

objectives.zh: 分得清几个词的关系：AI ⊃ 机器学习 ⊃ 深度学习 ⊃ 大语言模型；人写规则的办法也算 AI
objectives.en: Tell the terms apart: AI ⊃ machine learning ⊃ deep learning ⊃ large language models; rule-based programs also count as AI

objectives.zh: 知道数据决定 AI 的本事和毛病，包括偏见；评价一个 AI 先问它从什么数据里学
objectives.en: Know that data shapes both what an AI can do and its flaws, bias included; to judge an AI, first ask what data it learned from

quiz.zh: 下面哪件事，最需要让电脑「从例子里学」，而不是由人把规则写好？
quiz.en: Which task most needs a computer to learn from examples, rather than follow rules people write?

zh: A 按税率计算个人所得税
B 判断一段录音里的人是不是在生气
C 按出发时间给航班排序
D 把摄氏度换算成华氏度
en: A Calculating income tax from tax brackets
B Telling whether the speaker in a recording is angry
C Sorting flights by departure time
D Converting Celsius to Fahrenheit

misconception_choices.A: 以为凡是电脑做的事都叫 AI / 都要学

quiz.zh: 一个识别鸟类的 App 能认出几百种鸟。它最可能是怎么做出来的？
quiz.en: A bird-ID app can recognize hundreds of species. How was it most likely built?

zh: A 程序员为每种鸟写下羽毛、喙、体型的规则
B 给模型看大量标好鸟名的照片，让它自己找规律
C 把所有鸟的照片存起来，拍到一模一样的就报名字
D 让模型上网搜索每张照片
en: A Programmers wrote rules about feathers, beaks and size for each species
B A model was shown many photos labeled with species names and found the patterns itself
C It stores every bird photo and names an exact match
D The model searches the web for each photo

misconception_choices.A: AI 背后是人写好的规则或答案
misconception_choices.C: AI 是把见过的东西原样存起来查表

quiz.zh: 小王训练了一个识别手写字母的模型。要知道它在真实使用中准不准，最好的检验办法是？
quiz.en: Someone trains a model to read handwritten letters. What is the best way to find out how well it will do in real use?

zh: A 用训练时给它看过的字母考它
B 用一批训练时从没给它看过的字母考它
C 看它说出答案时的把握有多高
D 数一数模型有多大
en: A Test it on the letters it was trained on
B Test it on letters it never saw during training
C Check how confident it sounds
D Count how big the model is

misconception_choices.A: 在学过的数据上考得好就等于会了

quiz.zh: 一个只学过猫狗照片的模型，看到一张兔子照片，说「狗，把握 90%」。这说明什么？
quiz.en: A model trained only on cats and dogs is shown a rabbit and says "dog, 90% sure." What does this show?

zh: A 兔子长得确实像狗
B 模型坏了，需要重装
C 它只能在学过的选项里挑，把握高也不代表对
D 对这张兔子图，90% 说明它有九成可能是对的
en: A Rabbits really do look like dogs
B The model is broken and must be reinstalled
C It can only choose among what it learned, and high confidence doesn't mean it's right
D For this rabbit photo, 90% means it is probably right

misconception_choices.A: 相信模型的答案一定有道理

zh: A AI 就是指聊天机器人
B 机器学习包含 AI
C 大语言模型是深度学习的一种，深度学习属于机器学习
D 人写规则的程序不能算 AI
en: A AI just means chatbots
B Machine learning contains AI
C Large language models are a kind of deep learning, which is part of machine learning
D Programs built from hand-written rules can't count as AI

quiz.zh: 一家医院用过去十年的病历训练 AI，而这些病人大多是城市居民。用到农村病人身上时，最该担心什么？
quiz.en: A hospital trains an AI on ten years of patient records, mostly from city residents. What is the biggest worry when it is used on rural patients?

zh: A 不用担心，AI 是客观的
B 它学到的规律可能不适合农村病人，甚至带着偏差
C 病历太多，模型会算不过来
D 只要把握高就没问题
en: A No worry, AI is objective
B What it learned may not fit rural patients and may carry a bias
C Too many records will overload it
D As long as it's confident, it's fine

prompt.zh: 请用两三句话，给一个没接触过 AI 的朋友解释：今天的 AI 是怎么「学会」一件事的？
prompt.en: In two or three sentences, explain to a friend who knows nothing about AI how today's AI "learns" to do something.

propositions: 不是人把规则写好，而是给它很多带答案的例子
它自己从例子里找出规律，再用到没见过的新东西上
（加分）例子越多越准，但也会出错、会照学数据里的偏见
（加分）它给的是带把握的预测，不是一定对
misconceptions: AI 背后是程序员写好的答案库

pass_rule: 每个学习目标至少有一道题，真人后测正确率比前测提升、且 ≥ 2/3 的人答对；讲回来覆盖前两条要点、不出现误解。AI 学生结果只用于改题与找讲稿漏洞，不作过关依据。
